title: Checkpoint: rocker-arm Lyon Table 1 parity gate
description:
Once PATCH-44 + PATCH-81 + PATCH-82 land, run BenchmarkRockerArmLyon at α=15° and produce a checkpoint comparison table against Lyon 2021 Table 1 ROCKERARM row:

| metric | paper | acceptable range |
|---|---|---|
| #Faces | 20088 | exact |
| #Sing | 36 | ±10% |
| #Traces | 144 | ±10% |
| #Arcs | 2742 | ±15% |
| #Vars | 192 | ±5% |
| #P | 159 | ±10% |
| dmean | 3.7° | ±2° |
| dmax | 14.7° | ≤ α + 2° |
| MSJavg | 0.989 | n/a until PATCH-75 |
| tMCG | 92ms | ≤ 500ms |
| tILP | 30ms | ≤ 2s |

Also save the rendered overlay PNG side-by-side with paper Figure 7 (or whichever rocker-arm figure exists) for visual comparison.

**2026-04-29 first run with PATCH-44 + PATCH-84 v1:**
- ✓ #Arcs 2753 vs paper 2742 (within 10%, headline)
- ~ #Sing 32 vs 36, #Traces 128 vs 144 (within 20% — cross-field diff)
- ✗ #Vars 2521 vs 192 (needs PATCH-84 v2 deeper strip walking)
- ✗ #P 265 vs 159 (needs §6 arc-collapse merging)
- dmean/dmax NaN-equivalent because dmax keyed on raw stepUv (PATCH-78 issue persists for INTERIOR arcs)
- ILP falls back to per-arc rounding when K>1000 (avoid OOM on the ojAlgo solver)

Checkpoint open: needs followup work on #Vars and #P before PATCH-57 DSL emission can use a 'paper-quality' layout.

Diagnostic deep-dive 2026-04-29: 96% of opposing-side pairs in our T-mesh are SYMMETRIC (counts match) so strip-eq precondition holds. Strip-walking via union-find IS correct (chain propagation through shared arcs). Limiting factor: 153 of 272 emitted patches are TRIANGLES (3-valent singularity wedges from PATCH-79). Triangles break strip chains. Lyon paper assumes ALL patches rectangular; the alpha-bound is meant to ensure no triangles emerge. Our triangles emerge from 3-valent sings (irregular vertex valence != 4). Hypothesis: Lyon's S6 T-junction extension transforms triangle cells into degenerate quads. PATCH-77 v1 doesnt yet do this.
definition-of-done: Comparison table prints from the benchmark; an automated test in MetrikoStageRegressionTest asserts each metric is within its acceptable range. PASS = we can claim Lyon 2021 algorithmically replicated. Save side-by-side PNG to test-output/lyon-paper-comparison/.
testing-plan: 1. mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=ixdar.entrypoint.BenchmarkRockerArmLyon at α=15°. 2. Compare each metric to range. 3. Visual diff against paper rocker-arm image (if visible in Figure 5/7/9).
